open_points.subject: backup snapshot instant
open_points.text: A18 says both “the instant being when its read transaction began” and “the instant is read from the clock at that [first audit-counter] read”; State 3 likewise says both “when the copy's read transaction begins” and “with the clock read then” at the first read, while flow:daily_backup now uses the first-read instant.
open_points.question: Is a backup's recorded instant the instant the read transaction begins, or the instant its first read fixes the snapshot?
options: Record the instant when the read transaction begins.
Record the instant when the first audit-counter read fixes the snapshot.
open_points.default_guess: Use the first audit-counter read, because the changed passages explicitly make that read the snapshot boundary.

witness.initial: A due backup starts while the store's audit counter is 10.
events: module:store begins the backup's read transaction at 03:00:00 UTC.
An owner action commits audit entry 11 at 03:00:01 UTC.
module:store first reads the audit counter, fixing the snapshot, at 03:00:02 UTC.
outcomes: Under the transaction-begin passages, the backup records 03:00:00 UTC.
Under the changed first-read passages, the same backup records 03:00:02 UTC; its kept name, displayed newest-backup instant and 30-day age therefore differ.
witness.observer: The owner viewing backup status, and module:backups when naming and rotating the backup.
